title: 雷达辐射源识别中的相似性引导时间编码
excerpt: 记录 SGTE-SNN 思路中时间编码、相似性约束与雷达信号去噪识别之间的关系。
content:
核心想法

雷达辐射源信号具有复杂的时序结构。相似性引导时间编码尝试把样本间结构信息注入脉冲时刻表达，使 SNN 在噪声环境下保留更稳定的判别线索。

后续整理

可以继续补充数据预处理、编码模块、损失函数设计和 ICASSP 2026 论文中的实验设置。

en.title: Similarity-guided temporal encoding for radar emitter recognition
en.excerpt: Connections between temporal encoding, similarity constraints, and radar denoising and recognition in SGTE-SNN.
en.content:
Core idea

Radar emitter signals have complex temporal structure. Similarity-guided temporal encoding introduces relationships between samples into spike timing, helping SNNs retain more stable discriminative evidence in noisy conditions.

Reading focus

Further notes may cover preprocessing, encoding modules, loss design, and the experimental settings of the ICASSP 2026 paper.
